basic_info.description: 1 bedroom with den Below Market Rate (BMR) housing opportunity available at 80% Area Median Income (AMI). Maximum income for 1 person = $83,900; 2 = $95,900; 3 = $107,900, 4 = $119,900; 5 = $129,500 etc. Must be 1st-time homebuyer & income eligible. Unit available thru the Mayor's Office of Housing and Community Development (MOHCD) & subject to resale controls, monitoring & other restrictions. Unit will be listed on DAHLIA, the SF Housing Portal (https://housing.sfgov.org) starting on the application date, 8-30-2024. Visit https://housing.sfgov.org for application & program info. Application, loan pre-approval, and homebuyer education verification due on 9-20-2024 at 5:00 PM. Fair Housing Opportunity.
